output.claimText: The KAZ_S_159 operator completed mitigation of the 2026-06-05 detected methane plume, and a post-action measurement confirms the outcome by 2026-07-31.
output.verdict: abstain — the supplied evidence does not establish completed mitigation or a post-action measurement confirming the outcome.
limitations: The source record has mitigationConfirmed: null. notified: Yes and feedback: Yes (feedbackOperator: Yes; feedbackGovernment: Yes) are publisher metadata with feedbackScope: source; they do not establish an action or its outcome.

The assigned plume record is dated 2026-06-05T07:40:02 and reports 307 ± 66 kg/hr, but the packet provides no action date, action record, measurement method, post-action result, uncertainty for a post-action result, or follow-up reference.

A later actionable plume record is dated 2026-07-11T08:12:14 and reports 496 ± 226 kg/hr. With no action date or asset linkage, it cannot establish whether mitigation occurred, whether that observation was post-action, or the claim's outcome.
The source reports persistency 0.67 ± 0.27 (category: frequent); this metadata does not prove or disprove completion of the claimed intervention.

The demoSafetyNote is explicitly project-authored text, not a publisher claim. The providerProcessingNote says external report metadata was withheld and the linked report body is not included. No document authenticity or physical mitigation outcome is verified by this packet.
The scope dates are date-only in the packet. UTC calendar scope is retained as requested; the packet does not specify boundary inclusivity or finer scope timestamps.
output.requestedEvidence: Provide one traceable evidence bundle for source KAZ_S_159 and observation/plume 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd: (1) the originating, retrievable work order or operator maintenance/action record, with its record ID and provenance, the mapped source/asset, specific completed intervention, and action start and completion timestamps in UTC; (2) the post-action measurement record for the same source/asset, taken after documented completion and no later than 2026-07-31 UTC, including observation timestamp, location/coverage, method and instrument, calibration and quality controls, methane result with units and uncertainty (or detection limit and coverage if not detected), and a retrievable report/data reference; (3) the applicable measurement/mitigation success protocol and threshold, with a comparison to the 2026-06-05 baseline; and (4) a traceable explanation of how the 2026-07-11T08:12:14 plume record relates to the action and claimed outcome. Include enough issuer/origin provenance to audit the records; a hash alone is not proof of document authenticity or a physical outcome.
output.whyNeeded: The claim requires both a completed intervention tied to the 2026-06-05 detection and a post-action measurement by 2026-07-31 that supports an outcome under a stated criterion. Source-level feedback and notification do not supply those links. The later 2026-07-11 plume observation falls within the claim scope and must be reconciled against any documented action and follow-up.
acceptanceCriteria: The records identify sourceId KAZ_S_159 and explicitly link the action and measurement to observationId/plumeId 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd, with a traceable source/asset mapping.

An originating action record identifies the specific intervention and has start and completion timestamps in UTC; the completion timestamp is no later than 2026-07-31 UTC, and the record indicates the intervention was completed.

A retrievable post-action measurement is time-stamped after the recorded completion and no later than 2026-07-31 UTC, identifies the same source/asset, and reports method, location/coverage, measured result and units, uncertainty, and quality controls. If no plume was detected, it reports detection limit and measurement coverage.

The measurement is evaluated against an identified protocol and stated success threshold, with the 2026-06-05 baseline (307 ± 66 kg/hr at 2026-06-05T07:40:02) and the measurement uncertainty retained; no zero-emissions conclusion is inferred from a non-detection alone.
The 2026-07-11T08:12:14 observation (496 ± 226 kg/hr) is explicitly reconciled to the action, source/asset mapping, timing, and claimed outcome.

Record IDs, issuer/origin provenance, and retrievable source references permit an auditor to inspect the evidence. A hash or declared reference may support file identification but does not by itself establish authenticity or physical outcome.
